parameters.name: OperateType
parameters.description: The method to handle the vulnerability. Set the value to **vul_fix**, which indicates fixing the vulnerability.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of vulnerability to fix. Set the value to **cve**, which indicates a Linux software vulnerability.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to fix the vulnerabilities.

parameters.name: VulNames
parameters.description: The names of the vulnerabilities to fix.
